verdicts.reason: A has the wrong hierarchy. The three flavour chips are blown up to the same visual weight as the CTA and stretch almost edge to edge, so they compete with 'Shop Flavours'. The headline is undersized, there's an awkwardly large gap between it and the subhead, the CTA sits jammed against the end of the subhead line, and the HONEY ROSEMARY chip runs into the right decorative circle. B keeps a clear hierarchy: a large headline, a prominent CTA, and small subordinate chips on a shared left edge. It still has flaws: the CTA nearly touches the subhead, and the chips and fine print leave dead space at bottom right.
